title: smp-max: certified maximum numbers of stable matchings (f(5) = 16, f(6) = 48, f(7) >= 85)
description: Machine-checked determination of the maximum number f(n) of stable matchings of an n x n stable-marriage instance for n = 5 and n = 6, and a new lower bound for n = 7. f(5) = 16 and f(6) = 48 are Lean 4 theorems (f5_eq_16_of_unsat, f6_eq_48_of_unsat) whose only hypothesis is the unsatisfiability of Lean-defined CNF formulas (120 cube formulas at order 5; 318,736 cube formulas at order 6), each refuted by a SAT solver with the refutation checked by the formally verified LRAT checker cake_lpr. The deposit contains the Lean development, the certificate campaign's audited journal (per-cube formula and certificate hashes), the identity checks between the Lean definitions and the solved formulas, the verification guide, and the paper sources.
